name: Los Angeles Chargers
status: Phase B d4 (2026-09-23): REDESIGNED (2020 powder blue identity, 2026 schedule): home powder blue jersey over gold pants with powder blue socks (weeks 2 and 15), road white over white with powder blue socks (weeks 8 and 14). Gold shoulder bolts, a bolt down the pants seam, white helmet with the 2020 bolt, rounded numerals (Saira Semi Condensed Bold, closest OFL match: INFERRED). Bolt shapes lifted from the retail 1960s throwback sets (24H6, 24A6, 24A7), repainted in 2026 colours: shapes INFERRED.

venue.notes: Chargers home games at the retail Qualcomm scene (SoFi Stadium since 2020; Noah: keep the stadiums, only the team art changes). The standard 2026 SoFi end-zone design was not confirmed by any source found (only theme-game designs are documented), so the retail layout is kept and made 2026: italic CHARGERS (Saira Semi Condensed Bold, slanted) in white with a powder blue outline and a gold underline on unpainted turf, replacing SAN DIEGO: INFERRED, open item for the lab. Midfield: the 2020 bolt (full colour, hand step) replaces the 2004 helmet: INFERRED. Pads and the lightning walls powder blue (2026 photos: powder blue field-level walls); the lightning walls are recoloured by hand from the retail art (lightning kept). CHARGERS sign panels in powder blue; the small helmet picture on the chargerlogo sign becomes a white helmet with the gold bolt; fan banners carry 2026 players.
